guidance.statement: The Company expects crude steel production volumes of 11.0 – 11.5 MT and sales volumes of 10.5 – 11.0 MT in FY27.
The company's production plan for FY27 is 11 million to 11.5 million tonnes and sales between 10.5 million to 11 million tonnes.
FY27 sales volume guidance of 10.5-11 million tonnes maintained.
Net debt/EBITDA to fall below 1.5x in Q2FY27.
FY27 capex plan of approximately ₹8,500 Cr.
Cost reduction target of at least ₹1,000/t.

industry: Commodities > Metals & Mining > Ferrous Metals > Iron & Steel

operating_notes.text: Angul capacity expanded to 12.0 MTPA in FY26.
Steelmaking capacity expanded to 15.6 MTPA in FY26.
Value-added product share rose to 66% in Q1FY27 from 61% in Q4FY26.
New Angul blast furnace is at 11,000 t/day of 13,000 t/day capacity; Raigarh blast furnaces run at 100% utilisation.
Captive coal mix was about 50% in Q1FY27; iron ore backward integration rose to 28% from 16% last quarter, targeting 40% on an exit basis.
Jindal Paradip Port commenced commercial operations of Phase I capacity of 12.5 MTPA.
Sales volume increased QoQ supported by inventory liquidation in Q2FY27.
Raw material costs increased due to higher coking coal cost.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹16,217.93 Cr; net profit ₹1,041.24 Cr (against a loss of ₹303.59 Cr a year earlier).
Jindal Steel reported FY26 consolidated gross revenue of ₹62,412 Cr and a net profit of ₹3,361 Cr, completing its Angul plant expansion to 12.0 MTPA.
JINDAL STEEL LIMITED uploaded the earnings call recording on May 2, 2026, at www.jindalsteel.in/performance-highlights-2.
Jindal Steel hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 2, 2026, guiding for FY27 sales volumes of 10.5-11 million tonnes.
Jindal Steel's Q1FY27 call (July 25, 2026) reported adjusted EBITDA of ₹2,667 Cr and PAT of ₹844 Cr, with net debt/EBITDA at 1.71x and the slurry pipeline targeted for commissioning in August.
Jindal Paradip Port commenced commercial operations of its Phase I 12.5 MTPA capacity ahead of schedule.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹16,678.54 Cr (+42.7% YoY), net profit ₹770.64 Cr (+21.3% YoY).
Jindal Steel reported Q2FY27 consolidated net revenue of ₹16,704 Cr and PAT of ₹771 Cr; with net debt dropping to ₹14,786 Cr.
Audio recording of earnings call held on October 23, 2026 uploaded to company website.

watchlist.response: We have a mix of spot and contractual selling with a lag in rising/falling markets; ASP increased significantly in Q4.

watchlist.response: Management declined to quantify, citing ramp-up variability, and pointed to the 18-20% ROCE framework instead.
watchlist.text: Analysts repeatedly asked for quantified cost savings over the next two years from coal mines, DRI plant, slurry pipeline and port.

watchlist.response: MD acknowledged it is an area of concern, cited eight new senior faces and a stable 1,800-2,000 person middle management.
watchlist.text: Frequent senior management changes and their impact on strategic continuity.
